series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2011, Apple will double its U.S. and Western Europe unit market share in Computers.
entries.subject: Apple computer market share
entries.metric: change in Apple U.S. and Western Europe computer unit share

entries.quote: By 2012, 50 per cent of traveling workers will leave their notebooks at home in favour of other devices.
entries.subject: Notebooks left at home by travelers
entries.metric: share of traveling workers leaving notebooks at home

entries.quote: By 2012, 80 per cent of all commercial software will include elements of open-source technology.
entries.subject: Open source in commercial software
entries.metric: share of commercial software with open-source elements

entries.quote: By 2012, at least one-third of business application software spending will be as service subscription instead of as product license.
entries.subject: Software as a service
entries.metric: share of business application software spending as subscription

entries.quote: By 2011, early technology adopters will forgo capital expenditures and instead purchase 40 per cent of their IT infrastructure as a service.
entries.subject: Infrastructure as a service
entries.metric: share of IT infrastructure purchased as a service by early adopters

entries.quote: By 2009, more than one third of IT organizations will have one or more environmental criteria in their top six buying criteria for IT-related goods.
entries.subject: Environmental criteria in IT buying
entries.metric: share of IT organizations with environmental criteria in top six buying criteria

entries.quote: By 2010, 75 per cent of organisations will use full life cycle energy and CO2 footprint as mandatory PC hardware buying criteria.
entries.subject: PC lifecycle energy and CO2 in procurement
entries.metric: share of organizations using lifecycle energy and CO2 as mandatory PC buying criteria

entries.quote: By 2011, suppliers to large global enterprises will need to prove their green credentials via an audited process to retain preferred supplier status.
entries.subject: Audited green credentials for suppliers

entries.quote: By 2010, end-user preferences will decide as much as half of all software, hardware and services acquisitions made by IT.
entries.subject: End-user influence on IT acquisitions
entries.metric: share of IT acquisitions decided by end-user preferences

entries.quote: Through 2011, the number of 3-D printers in homes and businesses will grow 100-fold over 2006 levels.
entries.subject: 3D printers

notes: Edition covers '2008 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: '10 key predictions'). Found in public source: 10 top predictions.
